nom: The INKEY List Exosome Hydro-Glow Complex Serum

avis.titre: I really gave this serum all of the attempts!

avis.titre: Lots wrong with this product, especially dimethicone in a fi
avis.texte: I was excited to use this product, but the pump seems to be faulty because after about 50 attempts to pump into hand, only a little splat came out. Another 50-100 pumps later nothing would materialize. With what little I could apply to my face, I noticed dewy, hydrated skin that lasted for about ten minutes until the product dried. I believe any smoothing or dewy appearance are effects of the dimethicone, which leaves me wondering why dimethicone is used in a first-layer/first-application serum instead of a last layer product. If The Inkey List is adding dimethicone to what should be the first layer for application, how will any other serums sink into the skin when dimethicone is used as a primer, base, and filler for large divots or pores? Mind boggling that this is part of the formulation. I'm going to be seeking a refund because I can't use with a broken pump, and any other serums or skincare products applied after this serum would largely be a waste of money since the dimethicone will block absorption. I strongly urge the company to reconsider their formulation, or at least provide some information about intentionality in formulating product and where it fits into the daily skincare routine.
